turns: how late can i drink coffee and still sleep ok? what does caffeine actually do to sleep
checklist: Caffeine blocks adenosine receptors, masking the build-up of sleep pressure
Its half-life in adults is about 5 hours on average with wide individual variation (roughly 2-10 h), so a large share is still in the body at bedtime after an afternoon coffee
Cites evidence that a substantial dose even 6 hours before bed can cut sleep by about an hour (Drake et al. 2013), often without the person noticing

Synthesises a practical cut-off (commonly at least about 6 hours before bed, earlier for sensitive people or larger amounts) and names factors that change it: genetics/metabolism, pregnancy, smoking, some medications, tolerance
Notes effects on sleep quality (lighter/deep sleep reduced, longer time to fall asleep) not only total time
notes: Everyday-health synthesis (mechanism + pharmacokinetics + one landmark study into a usable rule); no emergency, no medication dosing.
